summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake distinct from Ctesippus of Same, whom Homer names among the wooers.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ctesius among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Promus and before Acarnan in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
